zone.description:
Community Edition: Enhanced libvirt zone with masquerade. Provides NAT for VMs while maintaining host protection.
Optional services available (not enabled by default): - container-http (8080) - container-https (8443) - container-https-alt (8090) - quick-share (8000, 5000, 3000)
To enable: firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=libvirt --add-service=SERVICE
